stage: X: RAFT (Relational Alignment of Frequency and Time with conflict-free gradients), the proposed method
declared_on: 2026-11-11, after the user's and supervisor's approval of the pivot (D-F1..D-F5) and before any Stage X run
title: RAFT: Relational Time-Frequency Alignment with Conflict-Free Gradients for Long-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
forecaster: configs/frozen_forecaster.json F_flatten_noLLM_v1, unchanged training configuration (Adam 1e-4, wd 1e-4, batch 32, <= 30 epochs, patience 5, min 5, best-validation checkpoint, test once). Baseline arms ('none', 'tfb_*') run the S2-R1 code path; RAFT arms use src/raft.py (RAFTForecaster with RAFTFDEncoder).

arms.none: alpha = 0: forecasting loss only (original model F)
arms.tfb_a<x>: TFB objective of Zhang et al. (Neural Networks 199, 108687, 2026) as implemented in S2-R1, fixed weight x (original model F). Breadth/few-shot use x = 0.01, the best positive weight on validation in S3 (most favourable to the previous method).
arms.raft_a<x>: RAFT: L_RT + L_TF with weight x, conflict-free projection, RAFT FD branch
arms.raft_rt_a<x>: ablation: L_RT only (+ projection, RAFT FD branch)
arms.raft_tf_a<x>: ablation: L_TF only (+ projection, RAFT FD branch)
arms.raft_noproj_a<x>: ablation: L_RT + L_TF, plain weighted sum (no projection)
arms.fdfix: ablation: RAFT FD branch, no auxiliary loss

data_sources: ETT: github.com/zhouhaoyi/ETDataset (ETT-small). Exchange, Weather, ILI: Time-Series-Library benchmark files (huggingface.co/datasets/thuml/Time-Series-Library), or the same files attached as a Kaggle input. sha256 of every file used is recorded in each part's protocol.json.

pilot.selection_rule: Among the RAFT candidates {raft_a0.1, raft_a0.3, raft_a1, raft_rt_a0.3}, select the arm with the lowest mean over the two settings of r = mean best-validation MSE (3 seeds) / mean best-validation MSE of 'none' (same seeds). Ties (|difference| < 1e-4): smaller alpha. Test data are not used.
pilot.go_rule: GO if the selected arm has r <= 1.005 in both settings. If not, the selected arm is still carried forward (it is the best available) and the report states that C2 is not expected to hold.
pilot.fdfix_role: descriptive ablation (architecture effect without auxiliary loss); not eligible for selection

arms: tfb_a0.01 (ETTh1_H336 only; ETTh1_H96 and ETTh2_H96 exist from S3/R1)
core.reused: 'none' (10 seeds) and tfb_a0.01 / tfb_a0.1 for ETTh1_H96 (S2/S3) and ETTh2_H96 (R1), 'none' and tfb_a0.1 for ETTh1_H336 (R1): same code path; cross-session reproduction to < 5e-5 test MSE was verified in R1.

ablation.note: a* = alpha of the selected arm; pilot runs on seeds 42/123/456 are reused where the arm is identical

claims_and_tests.C1: RAFT beats the TFB objective of Zhang et al.: paired test-RMSE difference RAFT - tfb per setting (mean, 95% bootstrap CI, seeds better); 10-seed settings: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm over settings; all settings: Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-setting mean differences, and Friedman + Nemenyi over arms {none, tfb, RAFT, DLinear, RevIN-Linear}.
claims_and_tests.C2: RAFT is not worse than 'none': 10-seed settings non-inferior if the upper 95% bootstrap CI of the paired difference RAFT - none is below 0.005 x mean RMSE of 'none'.
claims_and_tests.C3: RAFT improves on 'none': 10-seed settings Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p < 0.05 with CI below 0; breadth: Wilcoxon over per-setting mean differences, wins/ties/losses.
claims_and_tests.metrics: test RMSE (primary), MSE, MAE in z-scored space; SMAPE in original units; per horizon step and per variable
claims_and_tests.selection: only validation error selects anything; test evaluated once per run
